title: Teen Kills Woman at McDonald's Over Wrong Order
description:
Bodycam footage shows Atlanta police responding to a deadly shooting at McDonald's where 19-year-old T'Niya Evans allegedly shot 30-year-old Tamanika Woods following a dispute over an incorrect food order that escalated into a physical fight.
